message: Build a modern immersive dark-themed technology landing page for "Nebula", a fictional AI infrastructure platform, as a React app: professional hero section with strong typography, navigation with a mobile menu, feature cards, product showcase, testimonials, pricing, FAQ and footer, rich entrance and scroll animations, animated headings, count-up stats and an interactive animated background. Accessible controls, responsive on mobile.
